messages.text: Every line this package prints should carry the prefix defined in prefix.mjs. format.mjs and report.mjs each build their own line and neither uses it. Make both use the shared prefix, so the suite passes.

prompt.system: You are a coding agent working inside one small workspace directory. Use the tools to read what is there and change it. Read before you edit. Make the smallest change that satisfies the task, and do not weaken any test to do it. When the work is done, reply with a short summary and no tool calls.

response.text:
The test expects both `format` and `report` to prepend `${prefix} ` to their output. Currently neither does.

- `format("ready")` should return `"[swarm] ready"`
- `report(3)` should return `"[swarm] 3 finding(s)"`
